The '''Republic Medical Journal''' was a medical journal published in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It hosted a lecture by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tan Kirin]] of the [[Corellian Science Academy]] along with the [[Coruscant Institute for Medical Sciences]].<ref>{{TORcite|type=message|FW: Incredible!|Elara Dorne}}</ref>
